title: SakAI agent context
description: Compact facts for coding agents and automation. Paths are relative to repository root unless noted.

stack.realtime: WebSockets (not covered by generated REST client)
stack.mobile: Flutter 3.x, Dart ^3.10; packages passenger, driver, shared

add_or_change_rest_api: Edit openapi/swagger.yaml (paths, schemas, operationId, security, errors).
Implement backend: dto, handler, usecase, repository as needed.
Run ./scripts/generate-client.sh; cd mobile/shared && flutter pub get.
Implement mobile feature repositories/view_models/views; handle ErrorResponse.code (ErrorCode enum).
go test -race ./... ; flutter analyze for touched mobile packages.

websocket.note: Use SakaiApiEndpoints.webSocketUri in mobile/shared; envelope { event, payload } per openapi description.

commands.flutter_shared: cd mobile/shared && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
